notes.title: RATSHAKER™ SHAKES UP PS5 ON MAY 28, 2025
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=QIrYRaWOdt8;full][/previewyoutube]
Sunscorched Studios and Dark Product are proud to announce that RATSHAKER™, the unhinged pest-control simulator that took the PC world by storm, will make its console debut on PlayStation 5, starting May 28, 2025. That’s right. The RAT is going to console, and it’s happening May 28.

Rebuilt from the nest up for consoles, RATSHAKER™ on PS5 uses the DualSense™ wireless controller’s gyroscope to deliver a hilariously immersive experience. For the first time ever, players can physically shake their controller to shake the rat - an absurd, satisfying mechanic brought to life with detailed motion input and hyper-reactive feedback.

PS5 FEATURES INCLUDE:

 Gyro-Powered Pest Control – Shake your DualSense™ to physically control your in-game rat.
  Hyper-Realistic RAT Physics™ – Every flail, flop, and squeal has been finely tuned for tactile feedback.
 Effortless Pest Removal – Just grab, shake, and watch as your “problems” disappear.
Your rat responds to every shake... sometimes unexpectedly.
 No Traps. No Mess. (Some Guilt.) – A clean conscience not included.

This is your chance to shake, rattle, and roll in the most ridiculous way possible - only on PlayStation. Wishlist now via the PlayStation Store or pay to shake on launch for $3.49 USD | €3.49 EUR.

IS THIS THE END FOR PC PLAYERS?
Absolutely not. YOU are the original shakers. The faithful. The tremble-handed pioneers. This announcement exists here because we love you. You made RATSHAKER™ possible.

THE GLORY OF THE RAT SPREADS EVERMORE.

No real rats were harmed in the making of RATSHAKER™ or the porting process. 
Several controllers were.

notes.title: RATSHAKER™ - Supporter Pack
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258209/6236b1c7e8107a723bdd231a2f09637fd9e47f87.png

HEY RATSHAKERS,

DO YOU HEAR IT? THE SCRATCHING? THE CHITTERING? THE HIDEOUS, UNHOLY SHAKING OF THE RAT?

WE HAVE CRAFTED A NEW OFFERING FOR YOU ALL. A CURSE. A GIFT. A PACT.

INTRODUCING:

RATSHAKER™ - Supporter Pack

From the very first trembling grasp to the final desperate squeeze, you've been with us. You shook. You suffered. You understood. This Supporter Pack is for those who believe in the cause. The chosen ones who want to go the extra mile to support us and our spiraling descent into madness.

WHAT HAVE WE DONE?

SEVEN NEW SKINS - Grotesque, magnificent, unspeakable. All deeply, deeply wrong.
Toggle them from a new cosmetics panel in the pause menu.

PURELY COSMETIC – No buffs, no bonuses, no advantages. Just a RAT that looks & sounds different in ways you may come to regret.

A COVENANT BETWEEN US – This is no mere DLC. This is a PACT. You do not simply buy this DLC, you commit to it. We are bound now. You have chosen to sustain the unsustainable & now you fund the unfathomable.

You do not own this DLC. It owns you. 

OUR THANKS. OUR GRATITUDE. OUR PENANCE.

IN THE DARKNESS, WE COOK. The screens glow with the sickly light of our twisted creation, and we no longer know where the day ends and the night begins. We willingly toil in this madness, crafting horrors from the darkest depths of our minds. Your support keeps this madness alive. We keep cooking, we keep creating, we keep shaking, because we must.

Thank you. We love you. We fear you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617860/RATSHAKER__Supporter_Pack/

BUT WAIT, THERE’S MORE

You thought we’d stop there? No, no, no. The rot never rests, the vermin never sleep, and we are never done fixing things that should have worked in the first place.

 INCORRECT RAT PAUSE - When pausing the game, the RAT would un-squeeze but still be stuck in a frozen squeeze animation, as if time itself had rejected your grip. The rat now correctly represents its state (squeezed, dead, shaken) even when paused. The RAT cannot escape.
 RATS NOW SWARM PROPERLY ON DEATH – Due to a misconfiguration in collision parameters, rats did not properly engulf your corpse in a tide of vermin. This has been corrected. Your body will now receive the appropriate, overwhelming, rodent-based attention.
  TVs NO LONGER DEFY THE LAWS OF TIME – Previously, TV videos continued playing when paused, but their audio did not. This paradox has been resolved. Now, when you pause the game, the TVs will pause too.
 MISSING CHECKPOINT AFTER 2ND GENERATOR – There was a missing checkpoint in the basement after the second generator. This was not intentional. It has now been added, ensuring you don’t have to suffer needlessly. Just... the appropriate amount of suffering.
 IMPROVED UI TEXT READABILITY – These words should be seen. Now they can be seen better.
 CURSED VHS TAPES NO LONGER BLOCK MOVEMENT – Some VHS tapes on the basement floor trapped players in an unholy grip, forcing a restart. These tapes have been exorcised.
 BASEMENT SHOWERS NO LONGER CURSED – A misaligned shower cubicle in the basement showers has been fixed. You may now bathe in peace. But why would you?

HAVE A RATRATRATRATRATRATRAT-TASTIC DAY!
Make sure to restart Steam to apply this update.

Thanks for playing RATSHAKER!
Keep shaking that RAT! 🐀💕

- Sunscorched Studios

No real rats were harmed in the development of RATSHAKER™.

notes.title: RATSHAKER™ 22_11_24_04 - Major Optimisation & Fixes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258209/1fcdbc96c1ffd5315f7be2b38c5d1c227e15a3b0.png

Hey RATSHAKERs,

Lighting Adjustments:

 Set light draw distances to prevent visual popping.
 Disabled unnecessary ticking and collisions on non-interactive light meshes for improved performance.
 Removed Steam Audio as it was unused and consuming CPU resources.
 Rendering Optimizations:
 Adjusted post-process shaders to render before the tonemapper for a significant performance boost.
 Changed anti-aliasing method from TSR to TAA and reduced internal render percentage to 50%, maintaining visual fidelity.
 Disabled unused visual features such as depth of field, volumetric clouds, and reflections to improve performance.
 Locked graphical settings to medium for consistent quality across devices.

Gameplay Enhancements:

 Implemented missing gamepad inputs for rat interactions. Steam Deck and gamepads are now supported for gameplay, though UI prompts for controllers are pending future updates.

Fixes & Tweaks:

 Fixed floating door in the field house.
 Corrected instructional text clipping by scaling text dynamically (font size may vary).
 Resolved memory leak in cursed objects; idle vibration temporarily disabled.
 Replaced a broken sink on Floor 3 with a working one.
 Fixed missing audio attenuation for flies.
 Fixed sink and bath textures for proper fill appearance.
 Fixed overlapping toilet placement.
 Fixed an odd wall alignment in the bathroom.
 Omitted a checkpoint for the Floor 3 door to streamline progression.

UI & Accessibility:

 Adjusted popup instructions to support longer translations without clipping.
 Confirmed translation files are up-to-date and functional.

Known Issues:

 Gamepad UI prompts are not yet available but are actively being worked on.
 Idle vibrations for cursed objects will return in a future patch.

Thank you for playing RATSHAKER! 
Keep shaking that RAT! 🐀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258209/5b1a1b137a98a671a157c95962224f1185c8a236.png
A huge thank you to everyone who grabbed the RAT and couldn’t stop shaking!

With RATSHAKER™, we’ve clearly completely redefined pest control—no traps, no mess, no fuss—just a thrilling, satisfying shake that solves your problems once and for all.

You’ve experienced the rush of watching that meter rise, shaking the RAT into oblivion, and we’re delighted to see so many of you enjoying our "oddly satisfying" experience.

Keep Shaking,
- Sunscorched Studios

No real rats were harmed in the development of RATSHAKER™.

notes.title: RATSHAKER 01_11_24_02 - Various Fixes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258209/1fcdbc96c1ffd5315f7be2b38c5d1c227e15a3b0.pngHey RATSHAKERs,


 Fixed static in house not causing restart and leaving the player on a black screen.
 Options > Volume sliders should now behave as expected.
 Various fixes & logic sync between non-cursed & cursed TV.
 Fixed missing wife video on some TV's.
 Fixed slider spacing so they are now evenly spaced regardless of target language.
 RAT dialogue is now audible in all circumstances, due to ducking now working as intended.
 RAT VOX is now paused when the game is paused.
 Removed random VHS tape that loads when photo is ejected.
 Fixed missing (reported) RatGlowstickCrack achievement.
 Fixed missing (reported) VideoKillTheRatioStar achievement.
 Fixed missing (reported) wifeshaker achievement unlock.
 Improved ending & credits sequence.

Thanks for playing our little halloween experiment,
- Sunscorched Studios
